plot: Rex buys a Speed Pass to win the floor-is-lava obby but keeps sliding into the lava; the team, led by tiny Chip, uses Rex's speed to cross the last gap together.

script.title: Can a Speed Pass Beat the Floor Is LAVA? 🌋

beats.say: Run, run, run! The lava is rising and the checkpoint is way up there!
Blox, stop! That red block is a kill brick. Touch it and you respawn at the start!
Kill brick? Pfft. I'm a pro. I've watched, like, three videos about this.
Today's quest: reach the golden checkpoint at the top of Sky Obby before the lava does.
Ha! Good luck, noobs. I just bought a Speed Pass. Ten times faster!
Calculating. Speed Pass makes you fast. It does not make you good at jumping.
Details! See you at the top. Bye-bye!
Rex zoomed off so fast he forgot one tiny thing.
Wait. Which way is the top?
Excuse me. Can I join your team? I am slow, but I never give up.
Whoa, a zombie! Are you going to eat our brains?
No. I only eat snacks. Brains are crunchy. Yuck.
Woof! Woof!
Chip likes him. Okay, Zed, you're in. Team Blocky goes together!
Jump number one: the wobbly platforms.
Easy! Watch this. One, two, three, super jump!
Blox landed right on the red kill brick.
Oof! Respawn. Okay, that was a warm-up jump.
My data says ninety-nine percent of pros say warm-up jump.
Look at the pattern. The blocks blink before they fall. Jump on the green ones only.
Meanwhile, at the top, Rex had a problem.
My Speed Pass is too fast! I keep sliding off the edge! Somebody stop me!
Splash. Rex slid into the lava, and popped back at the start.
I paid a lot of coins for that pass!
Slow is okay. Slow does not slide. Come with us.
Jump number three: the spinning bars. Duck, jump, duck, jump.
Duck! Jump! Duck! Wait, which one was it? Jump? Duck?
The bar spun around and gently bonked Blox right back to the start.
Respawn number two. I'm counting them now. That's science.
Science says: watch first, then jump. I watched. You did not.
I will go first. If I fall, I just get up. Zombies are good at that.
And slowly, very slowly, Zed walked right under the spinning bar. He was too short to get hit!
Zed! You did it! Everybody, copy Zed. Walk slow and stay low!
I am not walking slow. I'm a speed pass person. Fine. Just this once.
Jump number four: the lava climbs higher.
Warning. Lava rising. We have thirty seconds. Or three. Maths is hard.
New plan! Gizmo counts, Zed goes slow and steady, and everybody follows Chip!
Why Chip?
Because Chip is tiny and smart. He only steps where it's safe.
One by one, they hopped from green block to green block.
Jump. Wait. Jump. Wait. Okay, now everybody jump!
Then, the biggest gap of all. Too far for anyone to jump.
Wait! My Speed Pass! If I run and you hold on, we can all fly across!
Rex, that is actually a great idea!
I know! I'm rich AND smart. Okay, mostly rich.
Rex ran, everyone held hands, and the whole team zoomed over the gap together.
We made it! The golden checkpoint!
My first checkpoint. Best day of my whole undead life.
Final result: speed plus teamwork equals one hundred percent win.
Next time I'm buying a pass for the whole team. A team pass!
Or, next time we just stick together from the start.
But far below, something big was watching from the lava.
Next time on Blocky Quest: the Lava King wakes up.

long.title: Can a Speed Pass Beat the Floor Is LAVA? 🌋
long.description:
Rich Rex bought a Speed Pass to race to the top of Sky Obby, but the lava is rising and Rex can't stop sliding! Can Blox, Pixel, a robot, a friendly zombie and a tiny pet dog reach the golden checkpoint together?
#obby #floorislava #animation
